theme_strategy.background_rule: Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A) as primary anchor. Never use pure black or light themes.

typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 max text-5xl sm:text-6xl. Do not exceed these limits. Do not jump more than 2 steps down for subheadings.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-24 for sections). Mobile-first approach.
spacing_and_layout.grids: Use 'The Bento Grid Protocol - Mode A' for the marketing content, 'Mode B' for Admin Dashboard.
spacing_and_layout.containers: All containers with borders MUST have padding to prevent collision.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly set hover text color. Example: hover:bg-primary/90.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Subtle framer-motion reveals on scroll. Tracing Beam (Aceternity style) on high-conversion cards like Prize Pool.

components.buttons: Sharp edges with intense red (#FF3333). Hover lifts (-translate-y-1) + shadow-lg.
components.cards: Flat background (bg-card), 1px solid border (border-white/10). No soft shadows on dark theme.
components.forms: Shadcn highly customized. Inputs have bg-black/50, border-white/20, focus:ring-red-500. Form must have a confirmation state.
components.navigation: Sticky top nav. Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60, border-b border-white/10. Do NOT use fully transparent background.

sections_blueprint.name: Navigation
sections_blueprint.layout: Sticky Fixed Top. Logo left, Links center (hidden on mobile), 'Apply Now' CTA button right.

sections_blueprint.name: Hero
sections_blueprint.layout: Full height (min-h-screen). Background image of trading charts with bg-black/60 overlay. Large 'Trading Ke Khiladi' logo text. '40 Participants. 6 Days. 1 Villa.' Countdown timer component. Big 'Apply Now' CTA.

sections_blueprint.name: Event Story
sections_blueprint.layout: Large expressive typography. High contrast red accent. 'A 6-day simulated trading reality show...'

sections_blueprint.name: Journey / Schedule
sections_blueprint.layout: Vertical timeline component. Left border with glowing red dots for each day.

sections_blueprint.name: Games & Challenges
sections_blueprint.layout: Bento Grid (Mode A). 4 cards representing '4 Teams of 10'. Tracing beam borders.

sections_blueprint.name: Mentors
sections_blueprint.layout: CSS Grid cols-1 md:cols-2. Intense dark portraits with red overlays on hover.

sections_blueprint.name: Villa / Resort Experience
sections_blueprint.layout: Asymmetric image gallery. Highlighting the luxury Thailand villa.

sections_blueprint.name: Prizes & Buniyad Course
sections_blueprint.layout: 2 prominent cards side-by-side. '₹30 Lakh Prize Pool' (Red theme) and 'Free Buniyad Course (worth ₹3L)' (Gold/White theme).

sections_blueprint.name: Application Form
sections_blueprint.layout: Centered narrow card. Fields: Name, Phone, Email, City, Age/DOB, Trading Experience. Submit button. Success/Confirmation state after submission.

sections_blueprint.name: Footer & Legal
sections_blueprint.layout: Massive bottom padding. Disclaimer text: 'Simulated/paper trading format. No guaranteed outcomes.' Links to T&C, Privacy, Risk, Refund.

admin_dashboard_blueprint.theme: High Density Grid (Mode B). Functional beauty. Solid black/gray.
admin_dashboard_blueprint.features: Login screen. Applications Table (shadcn table) with sorting/filtering. 'Export CSV' utility button on top right.

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break conventions! Use asymmetric grids.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute for testing.
instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Oswald' and 'Manrope' in index.html.
Update tailwind.config.js colors to match the dark theme outlined.
Build the single-page landing site in App.js or dedicated page components.
Build the Admin Dashboard under a conditional render or separate route.
Use lucide-react for icons. DO NOT use emojis for icons.
Ensure 'Apply Now' CTA jumps to the application form section.
Maintain high contrast. Red text on black must be highly saturated to meet accessibility.
